source_note: Continuous source608–611s: close STC protection and tall white privacy backing on left, pass beneath STC bridge at609s, then Qatar chicane610s and40-before-limiter611s. Bridge124m±15m follows speed/landmark registration; walls0–180m and144m screen endpoint remain estimates. Before pit route physically separates from RaceRoad, the left chain follows the outer envelope of both routes, not a wall through the racing surface. Existing road/kerbs, pit axis, limiter, garage fronts and Qatar chain endpoints remain. Wall0.95m, privacy4.2m and bridge6.2m underside/1.8m panel are visual estimates, not surveyed values.
